_comment: Chanel brand tokens for the eaef-multiprocedure-eater dashboard re-skin. Derived from chanel.com: white surfaces, near-black text (rgb(29,29,29) buttons/nav, rgb(51,51,51) body copy), no colored UI chrome except a single champagne-gold accent sampled from product photography. Status colors (go/conditional/no-go) are kept as a universal green/amber/red data-viz convention, deepened for AA contrast on a white background. To re-skin for a NEW CLIENT: copy this file, replace 'palette' hex values with the new brand's palette (surfaces, text, one or two accent colors), and re-run apply_brand.py -- no HTML/CSS editing needed.
